name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション タママロボMk-II
name.en: Keroro Sergeant Plastic Model Collection Tamama Robo Mk-II

description.ja: 人気のロボシリーズに“タママロボMk-II”が登場。
description.en: “Tama Robo Mk-II” is now available in the popular robot series.

description.ja: タママサブマリンへ変形可能。
description.en: Can be transformed into Tamama Submarine.

description.ja: ロボに乗り込むタママ二等兵も手足が可動。
description.en: Private Tamama who rides the robot also has movable limbs.

description.ja: タママはロボのコクピットにもなるソーサーに乗せることが可能。
description.en: Tamama can be placed on a saucer that also serves as the robot's cockpit.
